title: sts2.fun statistics
description:
Automatically uploads your finished Slay the Spire 2 runs to [url=https://sts2.fun]sts2.fun[/url], the community stats site (card, relic, ancient and event statistics, including causal win-rate effects).

[b]What it does[/b]
[list]
[*]When you start the game and after each run, it checks which of your run files sts2.fun doesn't have yet and uploads those.
[*]Shows your sts2.fun account name on the main menu; click it to open your player page.
[/list]

[b]What it sends[/b]
Only your .run files (the game's run history). Nothing else is read or sent. It does not affect gameplay.

[b]Turning it off[/b]
Set "Enabled": false in sts2fun_stats/config.json in the game's user data folder, or unsubscribe.

Source code: https://github.com/Deleetdk/sts2fun-stats
changeNote: Syncs 5 seconds after the game starts (was 20).
